newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia may sign "amended" De Beers deal.
newsitem.headline: Russia may sign "amended" De Beers deal.

text.p: A Russian deputy finance minister said on Thursday that Moscow would soon sign a trade agreement with De Beers, but said final details in the arrangement might be changed, Interfax news agency said on Thursday.

It quoted German Kuznetsov as saying decrees for signing by President Boris Yeltsin and Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin had been prepared, but that the documents contained "several remarks" that the trade deal should take into consideration.
Raymond Clark, general director of De Beers' Moscow representation, told Reuters this week that it was unclear when a trade agreement could be signed, given Yeltsin's recuperation from pneumonia.
But Clark said the text of the agreement awaiting Yeltsin's signature was unchanged from a draft accord of September 1996.
De Beers stopped all purchases of diamonds from Russia on December 31, 1996 when it cancelled its interim arrangement after Russia failed to approve or reject a new trade deal.
